name: Feature delivery
description: Ground the request, implement it in a bounded repair loop, verify it, and prepare an evidence-backed handoff.

adaptationRules.reason: Include browser, visual, and accessibility verification when the affected scope has a web interface.
Include migration safety when the run specification identifies a schema or data change.
Include package impact and integration checks when more than one workspace package is affected.

name: UI delivery
description: Implement a web-facing change and iterate against browser, visual, and accessibility evidence.

adaptationRules.reason: Add cross-package checks when the interface consumes changed workspace packages.

name: Bug fix
description: Reproduce and diagnose a defect before entering a focused implementation and verification loop.

adaptationRules.reason: Exercise the failed journey when the defect is user-interface visible.
Add migration safety if the diagnosed cause crosses a persistence boundary.

name: Monorepo change
description: Coordinate a bounded change across workspace packages and verify shared contracts in dependency order.

adaptationRules.reason: Add interface verification when a changed package reaches a web consumer.
Add migration safety when a shared schema changes.

name: Database delivery
description: Plan, implement, review, and verify a compatible schema or data change before release.

adaptationRules.reason: Trace all package consumers of the changed database contract.

name: Repository onboarding
description: Turn an unfamiliar repository into grounded rules, architecture boundaries, checks, and a reusable handoff.

name: Quality decision workflow
description: Implement and verify a change, then route it through an inspectable deterministic decision tree before release.
